name: Incident escalation with human approval (bindings fixture)
description: CACAO playbook fixture exercising the Temporal compiler's activity-binding + signal-hook generator. Contains a HITL action (CACAO `manual` command) and a playbook-action with typed in/out arguments derived from the playbook variable schema.

__incident_id__.description: Identifier of the incident under escalation.

__owner_email__.description: Email of the on-call owner the approval is routed to.

__ticket_url__.description: URL of the ticket opened downstream.

__retry_count__.description: Number of times escalation has been retried.

action--22222222-2222-4222-8222-22222222.description: Page the on-call owner and wait for an approve/deny decision.

commands.description: Operator confirms or denies escalation in the on-call UI.
